extraFacts.fact: ISO 8434-1 (the successor to DIN 2353) covers 24° cone compression tube fittings in the light (L) series and the heavy (S) series, sized by tube outside diameter in millimetres.

316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.

faqs.q: What is the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone used for?
faqs.a: The Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone is a 316L stainless-steel metric female swivel hose fitting with a 24° cone seat and O-ring (DIN 3852), in light-series metric threads from M12×1.5 to M36×2.0. It connects a stainless hose to a metric 24° cone male stud or tube end, and the swivel nut lets it be tightened without twisting the hose.

faqs.q: How do I read the part number IH-SS-THY-FDL-04-06 on the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone?
faqs.a: IH-SS-THY-FDL-04-06 is for a 1/4" hose (dash -04) and a M12×1.5 female swivel (6 mm tube, light series). In the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone part numbers the first two-digit number is the hose dash size and the second is the port size, so IH-SS-THY-FDL-08-15 is for a 1/2" hose and a M22×1.5 female swivel (15 mm tube, light series).

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone come in?
faqs.a: The Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone size table runs from hose size -04 (1/4") to -16 (1"). Ports run from M12×1.5 female swivel to M36×2.0 female swivel, and every part number gives both sizes.

faqs.q: How do I match the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone to the tube or stud?
faqs.a: Choose by the thread and tube size on the mating part: each part number pairs a hose dash with a port, for example a 6 mm tube light-series port is M12×1.5 and an 8 mm tube port is M14×1.5. The size table lists every pair up to a 28 mm tube at M36×2.0.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone have?
faqs.a: The listing gives the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone no pressure figure of its own: the pressure of the finished assembly tracks the hose grade and ferrule when it is crimped to the correct diameter. Pick the hose first, then confirm that the hose rating suits the metric M10×1 to M42×2 (24° cone) port before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone made from, and where does stainless suit it?
faqs.a: The Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone is machined from 316L stainless steel, passivated with no plating, so its corrosion resistance comes from the native oxide layer. It suits marine, chemical, food-grade and washdown service where zinc-plated carbon steel corrodes. The listing gives -40°C to +200°C, limited by the hose and any O-ring.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone follow?
faqs.a: The Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone is listed to ISO 8434-1 and DIN 2353. ISO 8434-1 covers 24° cone fittings in the light and heavy series by tube outside diameter, and this listing's rows are all light series.

faqs.q: What does the Metric female swivel with O-ring 24° cone connect to?
faqs.a: The swivel nut screws onto a male 24° cone stud or standpipe, such as the [Metric male stud 24° cone](/p/metric-male-stud-24-cone), and the O-ring seals the cone. The hose side takes an SS316L crimp ferrule; see our [stainless crimp hose fittings](/c/stainless-crimp-hose-fittings).

faqs.q: How is a metric 24° cone swivel with an O-ring tightened?
faqs.a: Check the O-ring is seated and undamaged, run the nut on by hand until the cone seats, then tighten the nut a set amount past finger-tight while holding the body. Replace the O-ring whenever the joint is opened, and lubricate the stainless thread lightly.
